e.title: UnderwriteKit：用独立 oracle 差分测试与变异测试，证明每条按揭规则在每个边界上都不出错
e.title_en: UnderwriteKit: using differential testing against an independent oracle and mutation testing to prove every mortgage rule holds at every boundary
e.title_hk: UnderwriteKit：用獨立 oracle 差分測試與變異測試，證明每條按揭規則在每個邊界上都不出錯
e.summary: 一个声明式按揭资格规则引擎：规则写在 JSON 里而非代码里，用精确整数「分」与基点运算，不做短路、每条规则都执行并追加带编码、观测值与所破阈值的理由链；作者自述重点不是写规则，而是证明每条规则在文档所述的每个边界上都正确、且没有死代码——对照独立分数制 oracle 在 50 万份申请上零不一致
e.summary_en: A declarative mortgage eligibility rules engine: rules live in JSON rather than code, arithmetic uses exact integer cents and basis points, evaluation never short-circuits and every fired rule appends a reason with a code, the observed value and the threshold it broke; the author states the point was not writing the rules but proving each holds at every boundary the documentation describes and that none is dead code, with zero mismatches against an independent fraction-based oracle over 500,000 applications
e.body:
**underwritekit** 是一个**声明式按揭资格规则引擎**（仓库 `Mohith26/fanniemae-underwriting-rules`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 25 KB、创建于 2026-08-25、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）**；**其 topics 逐字实测为 analytics、decision-table、differential-testing、fintech、integer-arithmetic、mortgage、mutation-testing、python、rules-engine、underwriting**。本条目属于本轮主题**「让判断可辩护」**——**它是四条里在**验证**上做得最深的一条**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**仓库描述逐字为**：**「UnderwriteKit: declarative mortgage eligibility rules engine in **exact integer cents/bps math** with **machine-readable reason trails**; **0 mismatches vs an independent fraction-based oracle over 500k seeded applications**. **136 tests, 100% coverage.**」**——**即：以**精确整数「分」与基点（bps）**运算的声明式按揭资格规则引擎，带**机器可读的理由链**；**对独立分数制 oracle 在 50 万份带种子申请上 0 不一致**；**136 个测试、100% 覆盖**。⭐⭐⭐ **README 实测 6,108 字节，其开头逐字给出了本项目真正的重点**：**「I wanted to understand what actually sits inside an automated underwriting system, so I built one: a small eligibility rules engine that takes a loan application and returns approve or refer with a complete, machine readable trail of every rule that fired. **The interesting part was not writing the rules. It was proving that every rule does exactly what the documentation says at every boundary, and that none of them are dead code.**」**——**即「我想弄清自动化承保系统里到底有什么，所以自己造了一个……**有意思的部分不是写规则，而是证明每条规则在文档所述的每个边界上都**恰好**如文档所说，并证明没有任何一条是死代码**」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其免责声明逐字，且是本条目最值得注意的一处**：**「To be clear up front: **the rule set is invented.** The thresholds are realistic in shape (LTV caps by occupancy and unit count, DTI bands with compensating factors, credit tiers, reserve requirements, loan limits) but they are **illustrative numbers I wrote for this project. They are not the actual guidelines of any agency, investor, or lender, and nothing here should be read as a statement about how any real underwriting system decides.**」**——**即「先说清：**这套规则是虚构的****：阈值在形态上贴近现实（按占用类型与单元数设 LTV 上限、带补偿因素的 DTI 区间、信用分层、储备要求、贷款上限），**但这些是我为这个项目写的示例数字；它们**不是任何机构、投资人或贷款人的实际指引**，此处任何内容都不应被读作对任何真实承保系统如何决策的陈述**」**。⭐ **其「How a decision happens」一节逐字实测**：**一份申请为十个字段**：贷款金额、房产价值、收入、月度债务、住房付款、储备（**均为整数分**）、信用评分、占用类型、房产类型、单元数；**引擎读取 `rules/rules.json`，按声明的求值顺序遍历规则，并且**总是求值每一条规则、不做短路（no short circuiting）****；**任何被触发的规则追加一条理由，含**编码、观测值与所破阈值****；**零条理由即为批准，否则为「转人工（refer）」并附完整理由链**；**「The rules are data, not code. Every cap, tier, table, and limit lives in the JSON document」**——**规则是数据而非代码，所有上限、分层、表格与限额都放在 JSON 文档中**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「有意思的部分不是写规则，而是证明每条规则在文档所述的每个边界上都恰好如文档所说，且没有死代码」是本轮最有价值的一句**——**它把**规则引擎的正确性**从一个「看起来对」的问题变成一个**可证明**的问题**；**对做核保规则、核保自动化或任何规则驱动定价的学生，这句话直接给出了验收标准：**边界 + 文档一致性 + 无死代码****（**可与池内 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读——**那三条分别处理可验证、可复现与基准，本条目补的是**规则层面的证明手段****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「对照独立分数制 oracle 在 50 万份申请上 0 不一致」是本条目的**核心技术手段**，值得单独记一笔**——**差分测试（differential testing）的做法是：**不用同一个实现自己验自己，而是另写一个**与被测实现无关**的对照实现（这里是基于有理数的 oracle），两者在大量输入上必须给出相同结果****；**这解决了一个真实问题：**如果测试用例与规则出自同一个人、同一种思路，测试就很容易与 bug 共享同一个误解****；**可与池内 [[contract-gap-overlap-benchmark]]、[[insurance-credibility]] 并读**（**⚠️ 本次未读其 oracle 实现，故不转述其分数制运算的具体构造**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 其免责声明是本条目在**诚实度**上最值得引用的一处**——**仓库名叫 `fanniemae-underwriting-rules`（房利美），而 README 逐字写明「这套规则是虚构的」「**不是任何机构、投资人或贷款人的实际指引**」**；**即**名字暗示权威，而正文主动否认权威****；**这正是本词条所在站点反复强调的做法：**把「这不是什么」写在最前面****（**可与第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「what it does not prove」、[[longevity-course]] 的授权与免责并读**）。**⚠️ 本词条据此**不主张**该仓库包含房利美或任何机构的真实规则**。**④ ⭐⭐ 「用精确整数「分」与基点运算」是一个容易被忽视但很关键的工程决定**——**金融计算用浮点数会产生**舍入误差**，而阈值判断恰恰发生在边界上**（**例如「DTI 恰好等于 43%」）**；**用整数分/基点可以把「边界上到底算过还是不过」变成**可精确判断**的事**；**对做定价、核保或任何阈值判断的学生，这是一条具体的实务纪律**（**topics 中的 `integer-arithmetic` 正指向这一点**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「不做短路、每条规则都执行、每条触发的规则追加理由」这一设计值得注意**——**短路（发现第一条不满足即返回）在性能上更快，但会让**报告只给出第一条原因****；**而本引擎**总是求值全部规则**，**因此理由链是**完整**的**；**对需要向客户或监管解释「为什么被拒」的场景，完整理由链比「第一条原因」有用得多**（**本次未读其实现，故不转述其性能代价**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「规则是数据而非代码，所有上限/分层/表格/限额都在 JSON 里」使规则可被**独立于代码审阅与版本化****——**这对**业务方与合规方审阅规则****尤其重要**（**可与池内 [[underwriting-copilot]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[uwmd]]、[[aws-underwriting-workbench]] 并读**）。**⑦ ⭐ `mutation-testing`（变异测试）出现在 topics 中，**正是「证明没有死代码」的手段**——**即**故意改动规则、看测试是否会失败**，**若不会失败则说明该规则未被测试覆盖**（**⚠️ 本次未读其变异测试实现**）。**⑧ ⭐ 本条目与同轮 [[underwriting-decision-safety]] 构成对照**：**本条从**规则与确定性**出发，那条从**概率与校准**出发**（**见该条注 ⑦**）。**⑨ ⭐ `decision-table` 与 `differential-testing` 并列，说明其规则以**决策表**形式组织**——**决策表是核保规则最常见的表达形式之一**（**本次未读其表结构**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件（`NONE`）****——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用、修改或再分发其规则与代码前应自行确认授权状况**；**② ⭐⭐ 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 十项、仓库描述全文、README（6,108 字节）的免责声明与「How a decision happens」一节，以及开头段落**，⭐ **但**未读 README 其余部分、未打开 `rules/rules.json`、未打开其 oracle 实现、未克隆、未运行任何测试、未核对其「136 tests / 100% coverage / 0 mismatches / 500k applications」四项声明****，因此**不能转述其规则内容、字段定义、oracle 的分数制构造、测试设计、变异测试结果或任何具体阈值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **四项量化声明（136 个测试、100% 覆盖、50 万份申请上 0 不一致、以及「无死代码」的推论）均为**其自述****，**本次未独立运行验证**——**本词条**不主张**其测试套件确实达到该覆盖率，也不主张其确实无死代码**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其规则集为作者自述的虚构示例**——**本词条据此**不主张**该仓库包含房利美（Fannie Mae）、任何机构、投资人或贷款人的真实承保指引****，**也不主张其阈值可用于任何真实按揭资格判断**；**⚠️ 仓库名本身含有机构名，**这是读者最可能误解之处，故本词条把它列为独立标注项**；**⑤ ⭐ 该项目为**按揭（mortgage）资格**规则引擎，而非保险核保**——**本词条收录它，是因为**声明式规则 + 精确整数运算 + 独立 oracle 差分测试 + 完整理由链**这一套做法对保险核保与定价规则同样适用**；**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ 一个命名与内容的关系问题需说明**：**`differential-testing`、`mutation-testing`、`integer-arithmetic` 均为**其 topics 自述****，**本次未核实这些手段的实际实施深度**；**⑦ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、仓库仅 25 KB**，**说明其规模小、关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度或已被采用**；**⑧ ⭐ 该项目是否处理任何**监管解释义务**（如 adverse action notice）本次未核实**——**本词条不作合规判断**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Mohith26/fanniemae-underwriting-rules` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 6,108 字节，免责声明与决策流程段逐字核对）；**未打开规则 JSON、未打开 oracle 实现、未克隆、未运行测试**。
e.body_en:
**underwritekit** is **a declarative mortgage eligibility rules engine** (repository `Mohith26/fanniemae-underwriting-rules`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 25 KB repository, created 2026-08-25 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)**; **its topics measurably read analytics, decision-table, differential-testing, fintech, integer-arithmetic, mortgage, mutation-testing, python, rules-engine and underwriting**. It belongs to this round’s theme of making decisions defensible — **and goes deepest of the four on verification**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"UnderwriteKit: declarative mortgage eligibility rules engine in exact integer cents/bps math with machine-readable reason trails; 0 mismatches vs an independent fraction-based oracle over 500k seeded applications. 136 tests, 100% coverage."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The README, measuring 6,108 bytes, states its real point verbatim in the opening**: **"I wanted to understand what actually sits inside an automated underwriting system, so I built one: a small eligibility rules engine that takes a loan application and returns approve or refer with a complete, machine readable trail of every rule that fired. The interesting part was not writing the rules. It was proving that every rule does exactly what the documentation says at every boundary, and that none of them are dead code."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Its disclaimer, read verbatim, is the entry’s most notable passage**: **"To be clear up front: the rule set is invented. The thresholds are realistic in shape (LTV caps by occupancy and unit count, DTI bands with compensating factors, credit tiers, reserve requirements, loan limits) but they are illustrative numbers I wrote for this project. They are not the actual guidelines of any agency, investor, or lender, and nothing here should be read as a statement about how any real underwriting system decides."** ⭐ **Its "How a decision happens" section, read verbatim**: **an application is ten fields** — loan amount, property value, income, monthly debt, housing payment, reserves (**all integer cents**), credit score, occupancy, property type and unit count; **the engine loads `rules/rules.json`, walks the rules in the declared evaluation order, and always evaluates every rule with no short circuiting**; **any rule that fires appends a reason with a code, the observed value and the threshold it broke**; **zero reasons means approve, otherwise refer with the full trail**; and **"The rules are data, not code. Every cap, tier, table, and limit lives in the JSON document."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "The interesting part was not writing the rules. It was proving that every rule does exactly what the documentation says at every boundary, and that none of them are dead code" is the round’s most valuable sentence** — **it turns the correctness of a rules engine from a "looks right" problem into a provable one**; **for students working on underwriting rules, underwriting automation or any rules-driven pricing, it hands over an acceptance standard: boundaries, documentation agreement, no dead code** (**readable with [[verified-reserving]], [[reproducible-actuarial-work]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] — those handle verifiability, reproducibility and benchmarking, whereas this adds proof techniques at the rule level**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ "Zero mismatches against an independent fraction-based oracle over 500,000 applications" is the core technique and deserves separate note** — **differential testing does not let one implementation check itself, but writes a separate reference implementation unrelated to the one under test (here a rational-arithmetic oracle) and requires both to agree across a large input set**; **this solves a real problem: if test cases and rules come from the same person and the same mental model, the tests readily share the same misunderstanding as the bug**; **readable with [[contract-gap-overlap-benchmark]] and [[insurance-credibility]]** (**its oracle implementation was not read, so the construction of its fraction arithmetic is not restated**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its disclaimer is the entry’s most quotable point on honesty** — **the repository is named `fanniemae-underwriting-rules` while the README states verbatim that the rule set is invented and is "not the actual guidelines of any agency, investor, or lender"**; **the name implies authority while the body disclaims it**; **exactly this site’s repeated practice of putting "what this is not" first** (**readable with round 319’s [[powmcp-skills]] and its "what it does not prove", and with the licensing and disclaimer of [[longevity-course]]**). **⚠️ The entry accordingly does not claim the repository contains Fannie Mae’s or any institution’s real rules**. **④ ⭐⭐ "Exact integer cents and basis points" is an easily overlooked but critical engineering decision** — **floating point in financial calculation introduces rounding error, and threshold decisions sit exactly at boundaries** (**for instance, debt-to-income of exactly 43%**); **integer cents and basis points make "does this pass at the boundary" exactly decidable**; **a concrete practical discipline for students doing pricing, underwriting or any threshold decision** (**the `integer-arithmetic` topic points at this**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ "No short circuiting, every rule evaluated, every fired rule appending a reason" is notable** — **short-circuiting is faster but makes a report state only the first cause**, **whereas always evaluating every rule makes the reason trail complete**; **for explaining to a customer or regulator why an application was declined, a complete trail beats a first cause** (**its implementation was not read, so the performance cost is not restated**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ "Rules are data, not code, with every cap, tier, table and limit in JSON" makes the rules reviewable and versionable independently of the code** — **especially important for business and compliance review** (**readable with [[underwriting-copilot]], [[underwriting-intel-mcp]], [[uwmd]] and [[aws-underwriting-workbench]]**). **⑦ ⭐ `mutation-testing` among the topics is precisely the means of proving no dead code** — **deliberately altering a rule and checking whether a test fails; if none does, that rule is not covered** (**its mutation testing implementation was not read**). **⑧ ⭐ This entry and [[underwriting-decision-safety]] in the same round form a contrast**: **this one starts from rules and determinism, that one from probability and calibration** (**see that entry’s note ⑦**). **⑨ ⭐ `decision-table` beside `differential-testing` suggests the rules are organised as decision tables** — **among the most common representations of underwriting rules** (**its table structure was not read**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`)** — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using, modifying or redistributing its rules and code**; **② ⭐⭐ this check verified the repository metadata, ten topics, the full repository description, and the README’s 6,108 bytes in respect of its disclaimer, its "How a decision happens" section and its opening**, ⭐ **but did not read the rest of the README, open `rules/rules.json`, open its oracle implementation, clone, run any test, or check its four claims of 136 tests, 100% coverage, 0 mismatches and 500k applications**, so **its rule content, field definitions, the oracle’s fraction arithmetic, test design, mutation-testing results and any specific threshold cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The four quantitative claims (136 tests, 100% coverage, zero mismatches over 500,000 applications, and the no-dead-code inference) are its own**, **not independently run or verified** — **the entry does not claim its suite really reaches that coverage, nor that it truly has no dead code**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ Its rule set is, by the author’s own statement, invented illustrative material** — **the entry accordingly does not claim the repository contains the real underwriting guidelines of Fannie Mae, any agency, investor or lender**, **nor that its thresholds are usable for any real mortgage eligibility decision**; **⚠️ the repository name contains an institution’s name, which is where a reader is most likely to be misled, so the entry lists it as a separate note**; **⑤ ⭐ Its subject is mortgage eligibility, not insurance underwriting** — **the entry collects it because declarative rules plus exact integer arithmetic plus differential testing against an independent oracle plus a complete reason trail apply equally to insurance underwriting and pricing rules**; **⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ A naming-versus-content point**: **`differential-testing`, `mutation-testing` and `integer-arithmetic` are its own topics**, **and the depth of their actual implementation was not verified**; **⑦ ⭐ ★0, 0 forks and a 25 KB repository mean small scale and very low attention**, **so no maturity or adoption is claimed**; **⑧ ⭐ whether the project addresses any regulatory explanation duties (such as adverse action notices) was not verified** — **the entry makes no compliance judgement**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Mohith26/fanniemae-underwriting-rules` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 6,108-byte README with the disclaimer and decision-flow passage checked verbatim); **the rules JSON was not opened, nor the oracle implementation, nothing cloned and no test run**.

It was proving that every rule does exactly what the documentation says at every boundary, and that none of them are dead code.**」**——**「有意思的部分不是寫規則，而是證明每條規則在文檔所述的每個邊界上都**恰好**如文檔所說，並證明沒有任何一條是死代碼。」**。⭐⭐⭐ **其免責聲明逐字，是本條目最值得注意的一處**：**「To be clear up front: **the rule set is invented.** The thresholds are realistic in shape（LTV caps by occupancy and unit count, DTI bands with compensating factors, credit tiers, reserve requirements, loan limits）but they are **illustrative numbers I wrote for this project. They are not the actual guidelines of any agency, investor, or lender, and nothing here should be read as a statement about how any real underwriting system decides.**」**。⭐ **「How a decision happens」一節逐字實測**：**一份申請為十個欄位**（貸款金額、房產價值、收入、月度債務、住房付款、儲備**均為整數分**、信用評分、佔用類型、房產類型、單元數）；**引擎讀取 `rules/rules.json`，按聲明的求值順序遍歷，且**總是求值每一條規則、不做短路****；**任何被觸發的規則追加一條含**編碼、觀測值與所破閾值**的理由**；**零條理由即為批准，否則為「轉人工（refer）」並附完整理由鏈**；**「The rules are data, not code. Every cap, tier, table, and limit lives in the JSON document」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「有意思的部分不是寫規則，而是證明每條規則在每個邊界上都恰好如文檔所說，且沒有死代碼」是本輪最有價值的一句**——**它把**規則引擎的正確性**從「看起來對」變成**可證明**的問題**；**對做核保規則或規則驅動定價的學生，這句話直接給出驗收標準：**邊界 ＋ 文檔一致性 ＋ 無死代碼****（可與 [[verified-reserving]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 並讀）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「對照獨立分數制 oracle 在 50 萬份申請上 0 不一致」是核心技術手段**——**差分測試不讓同一個實現自己驗自己，而是另寫一個**與被測實現無關**的對照實現（這裡是基於有理數的 oracle），兩者在大量輸入上必須一致****；**這解決了一個真實問題：**若測試用例與規則出自同一人、同一種思路，測試很容易與 bug 共享同一個誤解****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 其免責聲明是本條目在**誠實度**上最值得引用的一處**——**倉庫名叫 `fanniemae-underwriting-rules`（房利美），而 README 逐字寫明「這套規則是虛構的」「**不是任何機構、投資人或貸款人的實際指引**」**；**即**名字暗示權威，而正文主動否認權威****（可與第 319 輪 [[powmcp-skills]]、[[longevity-course]] 並讀）。**⚠️ 本詞條據此**不主張**該倉庫包含房利美或任何機構的真實規則**。**④ ⭐⭐ 「用精確整數『分』與基點運算」是容易被忽視但關鍵的工程決定**——**浮點數會產生**捨入誤差**，而閾值判斷恰恰發生在邊界上**；**整數分/基點把「邊界上到底算過還是不過」變成**可精確判斷****（**topics 中的 `integer-arithmetic` 正指向此**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「不做短路、每條規則都執行、每條觸發的規則追加理由」值得注意**——**短路更快，但會讓報告只給出第一條原因；而總求值全部規則使理由鏈**完整****。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「規則是數據而非代碼」使規則可**獨立於代碼審閱與版本化****（可與 [[underwriting-copilot]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[uwmd]]、[[aws-underwriting-workbench]] 並讀）。**⑦ ⭐ `mutation-testing`（變異測試）正是「證明沒有死代碼」的手段**（**⚠️ 未讀其變異測試實現**）。**⑧ ⭐ 與同輪 [[underwriting-decision-safety]] 構成對照**：**本條從**規則與確定性**出發，那條從**概率與校準**出發**。**⑨ ⭐ `decision-table` 說明其規則以**決策表**形式組織**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄，並提示使用、修改或再分發前應自行確認授權**；**② ⭐⭐** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics 十項、倉庫描述全文、README（6,108 位元組）的免責聲明與「How a decision happens」一節及開頭段落**，⭐ **但**未讀 README 其餘部分、未打開 `rules/rules.json`、未打開其 oracle 實現、未克隆、未運行任何測試、未核對其四項聲明****；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 四項量化聲明（136 個測試、100% 覆蓋、50 萬份申請上 0 不一致、以及「無死代碼」的推論）均為**其自述****，**未獨立運行驗證**——**不主張**其測試套件確實達到該覆蓋率，也不主張其確實無死代碼**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **其規則集為作者自述的虛構示例****——**不主張**該倉庫包含房利美或任何機構的真實承保指引****，**也不主張其閾值可用於任何真實按揭資格判斷**；**⚠️ 倉庫名本身含機構名，是讀者最可能誤解之處，故列為獨立標注項**；**⑤ ⭐ 其主題為**按揭資格**規則引擎而非保險核保**——**收錄理由是该套做法對保險核保與定價規則同樣適用**；**⑥ ⭐ ⚠️ 命名與內容之關係需說明**：**三個測試相關 topics 均為自述，其實施深度未核實**；**⑦ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、僅 25 KB**，**不主張其成熟度或已被採用**；**⑧ ⭐ 是否處理任何**監管解釋義務**（如 adverse action notice）未核實**，**本詞條不作合規判斷**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料未核實**（**README 為英文**）。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Mohith26/fanniemae-underwriting-rules` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未打開規則 JSON、未打開 oracle 實現、未克隆、未運行測試**。
